identity.normalization: ID-2: AQUA / WATER, CI 19140 / YELLOW 5 and PARFUM / FRAGRANCE each one entry; normalized one-based positions of the 19-entry list

surfactantSystem: Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 - strong anionic, ether type, defining anionic
Not cleansing: Glycol Distearate @3, Carbomer @7, PPG-5-Ceteth-20 @13, Sodium Chloride @17

wLine.alphabeticalRun: positions 11-19 (2-Oleamido-1,3-Octadecanediol, Parfum, PPG-5-Ceteth-20, Salicylic Acid, Selenium Sulfide, Sodium Benzoate, Sodium Chloride, Sodium Hydroxide, Tocopheryl Acetate; digit-led name sorts before letters); does not contain the earliest cleansing surfactant (SLES @2), so it is a tail; second entry = Parfum @12
wLine.plausibilityOfWLine: Parfum @12 is the earliest candidate: (i) SLES @2 before; (ii) nothing between it and the cap (it is the cap). W-line = cap; no fallback code

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 with the prominent buffer Coco-Betaine @4 and no reinforcing strong anionic. Settled C1 core; no C3b member involved.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: C2 not met (no cationic polymer). One meaningful system: prominent Dimethicone @6 suspended by Glycol Distearate @3/Carbomer @7, plus Glycerin @5 and a trace ceramide @11. Counter-signal: without a cationic deposition aid in an SLES chassis, silicone deposition may be limited, so low is the realistic neighbor.

reset: strong anionic ether type: Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2

weightPotential.depositionLoad: moderate - prominent dimethicone at @6 (suspended silicone system), no cationic co-deposition
weightPotential.persistence: moderate - dimethicone is a persistent, non-water-soluble film where it deposits
weightPotential.counterevidence: No cationic polymer to drive coacervate deposition; the only other family is a trace weak refatter; effective ordinary chassis.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Moderate: a prominent persistent silicone system is plausible enough that calling the product lightweight would understate residue risk.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not low: the silicone is prominent (@6, before Parfum) and persistent; W2 - with two families present, a low call would need the routes to be late/trace, which the dimethicone is not. Not high: one deposition kind plus a trace refatter, no W-RICH, moderate reset.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Deposition efficiency of dimethicone without a cationic polymer is unknown; could be one band lighter.
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: prominent Dimethicone @6 with moderate reset; no material payload lipid (W-line = Parfum @12, none listed); W1 not applicable (no guar, no amodimethicone).

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Selenium Sulfide @15 suggests an anti-dandruff role but the path needs a dandruff claim (R17.3).
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Claim direction null (blind); formula compatible with scalp_active if anti-dandruff positioning is revealed; provisional general.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no positioning visible.

losingTriggers: treatment possible if a qualifying dandruff claim is revealed

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Provisional: positioning hidden. CSA formula half met only via the humectant route Glycerin @5 (no E4 comfort route); prominent Menthol @10 is a counter-signal that would cap targeted at moderate.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Supported: Selenium Sulfide @15 is a recognized active (DS1, exact INCI name). Formula-only.

uncertainties: 2-Oleamido-1,3-Octadecanediol @11 read as weak_refatter (ceramide-type lipid additive at trace level); if read as payload_lipid it would be material (before W-line @12), W-RICH would hold with Dimethicone @6, but reset is moderate so the band would still be moderate (with high as neighbor).
conditioningLevel moderate vs low (no cationic polymer).
